user.title: Event Reel
user.description: Event Reel describes camera events with Home Assistant's AI Task and keeps them for the Event Reel card. Add cameras afterwards with **Add camera**.

data.keep_no_activity: Keep events where the AI sees nothing

data_description.ai_task_entity: Leave empty to use the AI Task set as preferred under Settings → AI Task.
data_description.language: The language of titles and descriptions, as a code (en, nb, de) or a name.
data_description.instructions: Added to every request, for example what counts as normal activity at your home.
data_description.keep_no_activity: Off: a false alarm leaves no event. A doorbell ring is always kept.

user.title: Add a camera
user.description: Nest cameras are described from their own event clips. Other cameras are described from snapshots when a trigger turns on.

data_description.name: The name the AI is told. Leave empty to use the camera's name.
data_description.triggers: Binary sensors or event entities that start a description, for example a person sensor. Not needed for Nest cameras.
data_description.nest_events: For Nest cameras: which events to describe.
data_description.frames: How many frames the AI sees: taken from the clip, or snapshots one second apart.
data_description.cooldown: Ignore new triggers from this camera for this long after one starts.
data_description.instructions: Added to requests for this camera only.

not_loaded.message: Event Reel is not set up or not loaded.

end_before_start.message: The end is before the start.

unknown_event.message: There is no event with id {id}.

describe.name: Describe
describe.description: Describes what a camera shows with the AI and stores it as an event.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera the event belongs to. Without a video or image, its snapshots are described.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name the AI is told. Defaults to the camera's name.

video.name: Video
video.description: A video to take frames from: a Home Assistant path such as a Nest event's attachment.video, or a media source id.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image to describe instead: a Home Assistant path or a media source id.

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: How many frames the AI sees.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: What triggered it, for example person or chime. A chime keeps the event even when the AI sees nothing.

store.name: Store
store.description: Store the event. Off: only return it.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Adds an event you describe yourself, for example from another AI or a script.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera it belongs to, so the card can show it with that camera's clip.

start.name: Start
start.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image to show with the event: a media source id or a Home Assistant path. Event Reel never deletes it.

remove_event.name: Remove event
remove_event.description: Removes an event and the key frame Event Reel saved for it. Only administrators and automations may use it.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Only events in these categories, for example person.
